params.caption: 🎮 Hunger, from the Hell Let Loose creators, hits Early Access on Dec 3 Good Fun Corp, the studio founded by the original Hell Let Loose developers, has dated its Napoleonic-era extraction shooter-slasher Hunger. It launches in Steam Early Access on December 3, and players can try it sooner through an open beta later this month. 🕒 Nov 11, 2026 · 18:41 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: Eurogamer #Hunger #Steam #GamingNews
